_meta.description: 營衛 in the panel (PM-52; docs/post-mvp/design/ying-wei.md): the dimensions, the natures with the readings that set their values, the questions on which the classics disagree (applicability-weighted, with a confidence), where 營 and 衛 come from, the stages of a warm disease, and what is not modelled. Weights are [calibrate]; every value is recomputed by the build.
_meta.rule: value = Σ w·v; confidence = 1 − Σ w·|v − value| / 2; the weights of one reading set sum to 1

readings.says: 營出於中焦 · 榮者，水穀之精氣也
readings.why: 中焦, 脾: where 營 is made

readings.says: 心主血屬營 · 營氣者…化以為血
readings.why: 心 and its blood: what 營 belongs with

readings.says: 上焦開發…是謂氣 · 肺主氣屬衛
readings.why: 上焦, 肺: the source the library can observe — 肺 signs go with a weak 衛 in its own 衛表不固 pattern

readings.says: 濁者為衛 · 衛者，水穀之悍氣也
readings.why: 中焦, 脾胃: what 衛 is made of

readings.says: 營出於中焦，衛出於下焦
readings.why: 下焦, 腎: the received text of the chapter itself, which sits uneasily with 決氣's 上焦; kept as the root (腎陽), at a low weight

dimensions.scale: −3 衛弱（衛外不固）… +3 衛實
−3 營弱（不能內守）… +3 營強（營鬱）

dimensions.en: Opening and closing of the pores
dimensions.scale: −3 開（腠理疏，汗出）… +3 闔（腠理閉，無汗）

readings.says: 陰弱者，汗自出
readings.why: The 陰 that is weak is the 營

readings.says: 陰脈弱者，荣氣弱也
readings.why: 成無己 names it

readings.says: 此為榮弱衛強，故使汗出
readings.why: Literally the 衛 is strong: it describes 陽浮 and the fever (「陽浮者，熱自發」), the fight at the surface

readings.says: 風并於衛，則衛實 · 衛為風客，則衛邪強
readings.why: The strength is the evil's; the panel already holds that evil as 風 (liuxie.風), so the 衛's own state is neither strong nor weak

readings.says: 衛陽為風邪所干，不能敷布 · 桂枝…溫通衛陽
readings.why: The 衛陽 is hindered and cannot spread: what the treatment acts on, 「溫通衛陽」

readings.says: 陰弱者，汗自出
readings.why: Sweating: the pores are open

readings.says: 以自汗出，則皮膚緩，腠理疏
readings.why: The pores are loose

營弱衛強.name: 營弱衛強
營弱衛強.says: 太陽中風: the 營 is weak and cannot keep the sweat in; the wind sits in the 衛

readings.says: 陽者，衛外而為固也
readings.why: What 衛 is for: securing the outside

readings.says: 衛氣者，所以溫分肉，充皮膚，肥腠理，司開闔者也
readings.why: and filling the skin

readings.says: 司開闔
readings.why: A weak 衛 does not keep the pores closed

衛弱.name: 肺衛不固
衛弱.says: 衛表不固: the 衛 is weak and cannot secure the surface

readings.says: 衛受風邪而荣不病者，為荣氣和也。衛既客邪
readings.why: 成無己: a wind lodged in the 衛 is what keeps it from the 營 — the reason 桂枝湯 「解散風邪、調和荣衛」

readings.says: 病人藏無他病，時發熱，自汗出，而不愈者，此衛氣不和也
readings.why: The clause names no evil, and the pattern's own evidence counts a recent wind or cold against it

readings.says: 此為營氣和
readings.why: The 營 is in order

readings.says: 以衛氣不共營氣和諧故爾 · 此衛氣不和也
readings.why: The 衛 is out of step

readings.says: 不能與荣氣和諧，亦不能衛護皮腠
readings.why: and cannot guard the skin

readings.says: 病常自汗出 · 自汗出
readings.why: Sweating

readings.says: 是以常自汗出
readings.why: because the skin is not guarded

衛氣不和.name: 衛氣不和
衛氣不和.says: 營衛不和 without another disease: the 營 is in order, the 衛 does not keep pace with it, and the person sweats

readings.says: 寒并於荣者，為荣強衛弱
readings.why: A commentator's scheme (風傷衛、寒傷營) that later commentators disputed

readings.says: the clause names no 營衛
readings.why: The classic itself: its pains are the cold's, which the panel holds as 寒

readings.says: 寒并於荣者，為荣強衛弱
readings.why: The same scheme: the 衛 is the weaker

readings.says: the clause names no 營衛
readings.why: The classic itself

readings.says: 無汗而喘者，麻黃湯主之
readings.why: No sweat: the pores are closed

readings.says: 傷寒脈浮緊，邪在表也，當與麻黃湯發汗
readings.why: The treatment opens them

衛閉.name: 衛閉
衛閉.says: 太陽傷寒: cold closes the pores; whether it also harms the 營 is disputed

not_modelled.what: 衛氣's day and night course, and sleep
not_modelled.why: It would need a pattern of its own (不寐 from a 衛 that cannot enter the 陰); no pattern enters the library outside admission (PM-21, PM-22). The reasoning text may cite it; the panel does not hold it

not_modelled.what: 營分、血分 heat and 清營
not_modelled.why: A stage of a warm disease that the red-flag screening sends to a doctor (Q6), never a state the app treats

not_modelled.what: 營 from blood, the other way (血虛 → 營虛)
not_modelled.why: 「化以為血」 says that 營 makes blood; only the 心-blood link of 溫熱論 is used (Q2)

questions.question: 衛出何焦

questions.question: 風傷衛、寒傷營

questions.en: Does the 衛 stage of a warm disease sweat?
questions.question: 溫病衛分之汗

readings.says: 在衛汗之可也
readings.why: It must be opened: the pores are not open enough

readings.says: 頭痛，微惡風寒，身熱自汗
readings.why: It sweats

questions.result: the readings cancel: no 營衛 nature for 風熱犯表 (EX3); the panel says nothing it cannot support

questions.en: Are 營 and 衛 qi of the body or stages of a warm disease?
questions.question: 營衛：氣，或層次

readings.says: 營在脈中，衛在脈外
readings.why: The qi: what the panel holds

readings.says: 衛之後方言氣，營之後方言血
readings.why: The stages: where a warm disease is

questions.result: not a conflict once the uses are separated: the panel holds the qi; the stages name where a warm disease is (see STAGES)

questions.en: Is a wind lodged in the 衛 of 營衛不和 without another disease?
questions.question: 雜病營衛不和有無風邪
